brands.name: Joso Surfboards
brands.short_description: Hand-shaped high-performance, fun, mid-length, and big-wave surfboards by Jose Luis Barboza Gubo in Punta Hermosa, Peru.

models.name: Robalo
models.description: ROBALO is a fish from the Moronidae family. It lives in the Peruvian north as well as in the Mediterranean Sea and in the Atlantic Ocean. It is a typical predator. It has a solid and robust structure, but at the same time an elongated and elegant line. Robalo is a model with a fish tail and two fins. It is a fish model more performance than the classic fish designed in the 70's. Less area throughout the entire outline, less thickness, thinner endings on the tip and tail, and, therefore, lower volume. The outline has pronounced wings under the fins and ends in a deep and narrower fish tail. The rails are low and soft against the flat of the board. It has an entry Low Rocker and an exit medium rocker that is accentuated with the V Concave in the tail. Triple Concave between the fins and a transition to a simple concave towards the center, and towards the tip another V Concave. Additionally, it has a slight Beak Nose. Part of the design is also laminating the board lighter to feel better all these variables and that the board feels more performance than a traditional fish. The measures of the original board are: 5'9 x 19 3/4 x 2 3/8 x 29.1 L.

models.name: Proto Tube
models.description: PROTO TUBE is the new model I developed in collaboration with Jonathan Gubbins, one of the most recognized tube riders in the world. This board is designed to surf tubular and fast waves. This board has a short and closed fish tail, keeping the outline as if the final part of a round pin tail board had been cut. This tail makes the board a little bit looser than the round pin tail and it keeps the line and security for this type of wave. Regarding the bottom, it has a low/medium entry rocker and a medium exit rocker, as well as a single concave that turns into a triple deep concave at 5/8 of the board and ends in a V concave in the tail. It has fine and sharp rails. What I highlight in this model is the extra area one foot from the nose to adapt the board to Jonathan's standing in the tube. The original measurements are 5'7 x 18.6 x 2.25 x 23.8 lt. A super board to surf the best tubes.

models.name: Bells
models.description: I participated in the AkuShaper Bells contest organized by AKUSHAPER, the most important brand of shaping machines and software design in the world. The challenge was to design a board for the world surfing champion Italo Ferreira to surf the World Surf League (WSL) Bells Beach Australia event in 4-8 foot waves conditions. The evaluation of the designs was carried out by the great Hawaiian Shaper Wade Tokoro and the AKUSHAPER team. I won the first place in the contest and this is the board that I made for Italo Ferreira. BELLS is a round (elliptical) tail, with a dome deck and soft low/medium rails. It has a low entry rocker and medium exit rocker. A single concave that comes from the nose and makes a transition to a triple and deep concave at 2/3 of the bottom. The extra area one foot from the nose is very important also. The dimensions of this design are 5'10 x 18.75 x 2.25 x 26.03 lt.

I have been working on the design of a good high performance board for small/medium waves for many years. In the 90's the boards were super thin and a little bit longer. In the 2000's they began to get smaller to look for a more progressive surfing. The idea of this model was to look for speed, looseness, and to allow you to maintain a line that keep the flow. This is how this design was created. It has been used by several surfers and all of them agreed with the idea for which it was designed. The original measurements are 5.10 x 18.3 x 2.2 x 24.1 lt. The tail is rounded squash, it has low and smooth rails, a single concave one foot from the nose which turns into a triple deep concave 1/3 from the tail; low/medium entry and exit rocker. 1001 is a super recommended board as your everyday board. A fast, loose and fluid board. Perfect for progressive and power surfing maneuvers on small and medium waves.

models.name: The Styler
models.description: I developed this model in collaboration with the Peruvian pro surfer Jonathan Gubbins. We were looking for designing his all-around board. THE STYLER is a small high performance board, with a relatively rounded outline, low volume, round pin tail and low rails. Regarding the bottom, it has a single deep concave and a low rocker. The original dimensions are 5'5 x 18.4 x 2.0 x 21.1 lt. THE STYLER adapted perfectly to Jonathan's surfing style. The result was a fast, loose and responsive board, solid on maneuvers. A good high performance board for your quiver.

models.name: Solida
models.description: When the channels are shaped on the bottom of the right board, they are a symbol of power surfing. Great power surfers used them in the past and still use them now. I designed the original SOLIDA for our team rider Roberto Ilufin. Roberto was looking for a shortboard to push hard and make strong movements. The board doesn't slide, it keeps the speed and solidity. The model has a round tail, good thickness along the stringer, medium rails, low rocker on the bottom, and it has 4 deep parallel channels that occupy 3/8 of the bottom. The original dimensions are 5'10 x 18.4 x 2.3 x 25.2 lt. This model is pure speed, drive and solidity.

models.name: Nueve1000
models.description: NUEVE1000 is the round pin model ideal for tubes. It's a heavier board that holds well on the wall of power and tubular waves. The perfect board to feel safe when you drop a heavy wave and go direct into the tube. It's a high performance, round pin, with good volume, medium and sharp rails. It has a medium entry rocker and high exit rocker. The triple deep concave is on 5/6 of the bottom. The dimensions that our rider Alessio Botteri uses are: 6'0 x 19 x 2.5 x 29.9 lt. NUEVE1000 is the high performance round pin that you need to surf heavy waves of consequence.

models.name: Heavy
models.description: HEAVY is a solid, fast and loose board, really good in several conditions. It was tested by various excellent free surfers and it had the best reviews. It's a high performance with rounded squash tail, wide on the center of the board and one foot from the nose too, medium and soft rails. It has a low entry rocker and medium exit rocker; single concave that turns into a triple deep concave on the bottom. The original dimensions of this model are 6'0 x 19.75 x 2.69 x 33.6 lt. HEAVY is the ideal everyday shortboard to be used in several conditions of the sea.

models.name: Africa
models.description: AFRICA is a board that offers fluidity, ideal for a line surfing in medium heavy waves. It is characterized by having an elongated outline, round pin tail, fine rails, low thickness and more weight. Regarding the bottom, it has a plane rocker on the center of the board and low/medium rocker on the extremes. The plane rocker on the center of the board gives you a better paddle and solidity on the wave, allowing you to use a smaller board on this type of waves. It has also a triple concave along the board. The original dimensions are 6'0 x 18.19 x 2.19 x 25.06 lt. AFRICA is really good to surf medium and heavy waves. The board holds strong on the carving turns, it doesn't lose speed and allows a fluid surfing.

models.name: 66A6
models.description: I designed the 66A6 having as a starting point the work of a Californian shaper. The outline is interesting because it's wide on the center of the board, it gets thinner towards the nose, and at the height of the lateral fins it has an inflection point and the line towards the tail goes almost straight. This inflection point gives looseness to the board and the final straight line looks for speed. The tail is fish, wide and shallow. It has a natural rocker, soft rails, single deep concave on the bottom and boxes for 3 and 4 fins. The original dimensions are: 5'10 x 2.5 x 19.5 x 29.8 lt. 66A6 is a very good option to have fun on small waves. The board is loose and enters easily into the critical side of the wave.

models.name: Chita
models.description: CHITA was created from a hybrid model I designed years ago. In this case, I made it smaller and I fine-tuned it a bit on the rails and other variables. The outline of the board has wings at the height of the lateral small fins. The fish tail is shallow. It has medium rails, good thickness along the stringer, low/medium entry and exit rocker, a single deep concave and a V concave on the tail. Plugs/boxes to use the board with 3 and 4 fins. The most used dimensions are 6'0 x 20 x 2.56 x 34.3 lt. CHITA is a very friendly board. Some intermediate level surfers use it as a transition board from a funboard to a shortboard. Other advanced level surfers use it to have fun on small waves.

models.name: Fun8
models.description: FUN8 is a super fun board for small waves. It's comfortable for paddling and catching waves; it's stable on the wave and it's easy to maneuver. The outline is made of soft curves; the model has a lot of volume; it's wide on the center and one foot from the nose also. It has medium rails; it's a round (thumb) tail with a low entry and exit rocker, and it has a single concave in almost the whole bottom. The original dimensions are 5'10 x 19.5 x 2.38 x 27.4 lt. If you want to have a good time, catching many waves and having fun on small waves, FUN8 is the best option.

models.name: Twin Clasica
models.description: I designed TWIN with reference to one of Gerry Lopez's designs, one of the most renowned shapers and surfers in Hawaii. It is a very flat board, with a lot of area and with a lot of volume. It is characterized by having a wide and deep fish tail, and by being used only with two keels with a wide base and a large area. The board has a low rocker, single concave and V concave in the tail; medium/sharp rails. The original measurements are: 5'8 x 20.75 x 2.63 x 33.6 lt. TWIN is the classic shortboard used in the 70s. A board for small waves with good paddling and super fun to ride with a classic style.

models.name: Mero
models.description: I designed this model especially for our 9-year-old team rider, Santiago Tejerina. It is a high performance board for boys and girls. Santiago trains and competes with this model. The board is super light, has a skinny rounded squash tail, skinny rails, low rocker, single concave in the bottom and boxes for use with 3 or 4 fins. The original measurements of this model are: 5'0 x 17.5 x 2.13 x 18.7 lt. MERO was designed projecting several high performance boards used by professional surfers and recognized free surfers. It is a board with which a boy or girl can feel light and free to do the same maneuvers that the pros do.

models.name: Mid90
models.description: MID90 es una tabla mediana que se posiciona entre una tabla corta (categoría Super Fun) y el modelo Funboard Rpin (categoría Big Boards). Es la extensión de una tabla corta, con una mejor remada, más sólida y para tener un surfing con una buena línea, más pausado. Es muy rápida para pasar secciones y es suelta. Tiene un volumen bastante menor que un Funboard Rpin del mismo largo, y se siente mucho más ligera y más maniobrable. Tiene una cola round pin, área extra a un pie de la punta, dome deck, rieles echados, high rocker de entrada y salida, single concave a lo largo de toda la tabla, cajas para 3 y 4 quillas. Las medidas originales son: 7'0 x 20.5 x 2.6 x 40.8 lt. MID90 es una muy buena opción para surfers experimentados así como para aquellos que están haciendo la transición de un funboard a una tabla corta. Ideal para olas chicas y medianas con buen recorrido.

models.name: Gun Ilufish
models.description: GUN ILUFISH is one of the most important projects I've had so far. It was born from the need of Roberto Ilufin, big wave surfer and Joso Surfboards rider, to have the ideal gun for riding El Buey wave with more control. The outline of the GUN ILUFISH has a significant area at 2 and 3 feet from the tip as well as good thickness in order to have a good paddle to enter the wave more easily. It is characterized by having a narrow fish tail; Roberto felt the board smaller than it really was, the board was easier to move and control in the drop, and especially if he went down close to the wall to look for the tube. It has a beak nose and the entire tip area has quite a bit of volume including rails. From the center of the board towards the tail, the rails are tapered to have more control. The bottom has a V concave at the tip that transitions to a flat area to once again enter the longest area of the board with a V concave to the tail. The board has a medium rocker despite the length. It has a four fins configuration. It is laminated so that it has considerable weight to ride down big waves. The original measurements of the GUN ILUFISH are: 9.4 x 21 9/16 x 3 3/4 x 77.72 L.

models.name: Funboard RPIN
models.description: This is one of the most stylish funboards I have designed and shaped. It has a round pin tail, high entry and exit rocker, high rails, and the nose is round pin as well as the tail. The board has a lot of volume for a good flotation that allows you paddling, catching waves and standing up easily. Besides, because of the type of outline and rocker, this funboard is more maneuverable despite its size. The original dimensions are 7'5 x 21.7 x 3 1/8 x 58.5 lt. FUNBOARD RPIN is a big board ideal for beginners and also for those intermediate/advanced level surfers who want to go out to have fun and catching many waves.

models.name: Longboard19
models.description: LONGBOARD19 is a big board with a lot of volume. It's ideal for beginners and also for intermediate and advanced level surfers who likes surfing on longboards. It's characterized by having a rounded nose, a rounded squash tail, and medium rocker. It has high rails and it's used with a single big fin or with 3 fins. The original dimensions of this model are 9'0 x 22.75 x 3 x 68.5 lt.
